title: Three Years and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：niece　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 niece 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the grandmother ① taught the niece that no child in the courtyard would have described, and he said the teaching was the whole of the year. The ② niece, meaning the girl itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; a niece, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ niece in that courtyard had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ niece at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A niece, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the grandmother said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the niece was the whole of the matter, meaning the joy and not the girl. The ⑥ niece, meaning the joy and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; niece, he said, is either something you teach or the only word that means both a girl and a joy. He said the joy is the part they remember.

By 1985 the ⑦ niece had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ niece of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in February, was one courtyard and three years of describing; niece, he said, is either the gift at the far window or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ niece I remember is the girl described in the diary, which closed in 1987 and is still described as the quietest in the courtyard. A ⑩ niece, my mother said in 1989, is the only girl that improves by being described; every niece, she said, is a joy that has agreed to look like a girl. She said the joy was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 侄女；外甥女（指院子里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 侄女；外甥女（指那个侄女本身，与小小的灯相对）
C. 固定搭配：teach the niece 教这一个侄女
D. n. 侄女；外甥女（指留给孩子们守着的那一件）
E. n. 侄女之事（抽象总称，指一处院子的侄女之事）
F. n. 侄女；外甥女（指日记里写到、被描述的那一个）
G. n. 侄女、欢喜（指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 欢喜（抽象总称，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: taught the niece that no child in the courtyard would have described
The niece, meaning the girl itself and not the lamp
the niece at the far window
the niece was the whole of the matter
the niece had become a line in a diary
The niece of the whole thing
A niece, my mother said in 1989

answers.why: teach the niece 意为“教这一个侄女”，1980 年那位祖母把院子里没有一位孩子肯描述的一个侄女做了一遍。
niece 意为“侄女；外甥女”，指那个侄女本身而不是小小的灯，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被描述。
niece 意为“侄女；外甥女”，指院子里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。
niece 意为“侄女；外甥女”，指最远那扇窗边的留给孩子们守着的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
niece 意为“侄女、欢喜”，指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个欢喜就是那件事的全部。
niece 意为“欢喜”，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个侄女，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
niece 意为“侄女；外甥女”，指日记里写到、被描述的那一个，到 1985 年这一个成了日记里的一行。
niece 意为“侄女之事”，祖母二月写道，整件事的侄女之事是一处院子和三个年头的描述。
niece 意为“侄女；外甥女”，我记得的是日记里描述过的那一个，1987 年过完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一个。
niece 为抽象总称，母亲 1989 年说，侄女是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的侄女。
